title: Hadith on Quran Recitation Rewards
summary: Reciting the Quran, even with difficulty, earns double reward.
translation: Incorporate the recitation of the Holy Quran into our routines in such a way that it becomes indispensable in our lives. This characteristic should define a Muslim. The Hadith provides no excuse for someone claiming inability to read the Quran. In the Hadith, even a person who struggles to recite properly is promised double reward. According to a Hadith narrated by Hazrat Aisha Siddiqa (may Allah be pleased with her), the Prophet (peace be upon him) said that a person who reads the Quran expertly will be with the noble, righteous angels on the Day of Judgment. However, a person who reads the Quran with difficulty and effort will receive double reward, one for the recitation itself and another for the effort put into it.
